question: What log lines, command-output fields, redaction rules, permissions, retention, and copy/export behavior should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be allowed to expose?
rationale: The feature is plausible, but it surfaces sensitive operational logs and command output in a new persistent dashboard context and depends on unresolved dashboard binding/security decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and binding security model first, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Existing Data
options.body: Allow a focused widget PR only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic stream bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Dashboard Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and binding security model first, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal is the Logbook native plugin-tab seam that this dashboard roadmap reuses.
